digest.component_or_area: reconciler bridge history rewrite and Jira cleanup
propositions: Six reconciler echo comment bodies exist with two live Jira copies each (preexisting survivors plus rollout-created duplicates) across three tickets

A nonmutating preparation phase must build an immutable manifest validating exact one preexisting copy and one rollout copy per body, emit authorized Jira cleanup actions, and produce a local history rewrite candidate that removes only enumerated echoes while preserving survivors

Jira cleanup must be GET-only by default with explicit execution digest-bound to exact six manifest IDs in canary order, logging all attempts and post-verifying survivor and non-target comment parity from a complete pre-delete backup

The coordinated execution sequence requires disabling reconcile-bridge.yml, verifying disabled_manually state with no queued runs, freezing both Git and Jira, executing exact-six cleanup, removing local COMMENT identities, verifying both sides, replacing persistent clones, then re-enabling only after non-resurrection checks
A complete independent bundle must be restored before any candidate; disposable exact-lease rollback/forward and stale-epoch refusal must be proven with no push or remote-ref update paths enabled

Whole-store replay must verify identical unaffected states, exact manifest subtraction on targets, retention of six Jira-backed survivors, byte-identical bindings, and fsck/topology/metadata/ref checks with logical byte removal accurately distinguished from pack savings
